deskyard account update: change an account

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] account update USER [OPTIONS]

Changes what the options give and keeps the rest; --grant changes the named
environments (=none removes one) and keeps the others. Lowering access, a new
password or --no-admin signs the account out of its browsers and closes the
connections it may no longer have.

Arguments:
  USER       string      required  username

Options:
  --password-stdin     set the password from stdin (password accounts only)
  --admin              make it an administrator
  --no-admin           make it a regular account
  --description TEXT   who it is for; "" clears it
  --grant ENV[=LEVEL]  set its access to an environment: ENV or ENV=full,
                       ENV=observe, ENV=none (repeatable)
  --expires WHEN       when the account ends: a time from now (2h, 7d), an RFC
                       3339 time, or never

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard account update anna --grant bob=observe --grant alice=none
  deskyard account update guest --expires never

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
